question.text: The maximum exit load in the FIRST year of PMS investment is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Max 3% in Y1, 2% in Y2, 1% in Y3. No exit load after 3 years. The Trap: 1% / 2% are later-year caps, 5% is outside the schedule. Cross-Exam Context: Same schedule in X-B PM section. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Disclose exit-load schedule in MITC; use calculator to show exit impact.
